title: A test-run wait with a host qualifier naming the wrong host reports "association_stale" instead of saying no such run exists on that host
outcome: When termal_resume_after_test_runs gets a host-qualified run id (host:<uuid>::test-…) whose host does not hold that run, the answer says plainly that the named host has no such run, instead of a pending wait marked association_stale ("awaiting authenticated native origin facts").
acceptance: A host-qualified run id that names a host which does not hold the run returns a clear refusal or detail naming the host and the missing run, not association_stale, and creates no pending wait for it.
A deterministic test covers a wrong-host qualifier for a run that exists locally; existing correct remote and local waits are unchanged.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
